# Leanks

> Leanks is a free, open-source (MIT), self-hosted URL shortener built on YOURLS, with a modern dashboard. It runs on ordinary PHP/MySQL shared hosting, so there is no SaaS bill and all links and click data stay in your own database.

Current version: 1.4.1. Requirements: PHP 8.1+, MySQL 5.7+ or MariaDB (pdo_mysql), Apache with mod_rewrite. No Node build step, no Docker.

Key features:
- One-line link creation (destination, short link, title), with advanced options one click away
- Password-protected links, and expiration by date, by max click count, or both
- UTM campaign builder with a live preview of the final URL
- Tags in 8 colors, search, sorting, bulk delete, rows or cards view
- QR codes generated client-side, downloadable as PNG
- Analytics: clicks over 9 time ranges, filters (link, country, device, browser, OS, referrer), ranked breakdowns
- Default domain redirect for visitors who open the bare short domain
- CSV import (column auto-detection) and CSV export
- Light, dark and system themes with a custom accent color
- One-click updates with checksum verification, automatic backup and rollback

How it relates to YOURLS: Leanks keeps the YOURLS core (redirect engine, database schema, click tracking, plugin API) stock and adds a small plugin plus a custom dashboard on top, so YOURLS itself stays upgradeable.
